For British companies, this creates opportunities to bring capital, expertise, technology and innovation into Jamaica, not simply through exporting, but through joint ventures, investment, local partnerships, technology transfer and the establishment of new operations. Equally, the Chamber supports Jamaican businesses seeking to access the UK market, develop international partnerships, attract investment and expand their products and services. BJCC sits at the intersection of these opportunities. Through strategic introductions, trade missions, investment forums, market intelligence, business networking, advocacy and institutional partnerships, we help businesses understand the market, identify credible opportunities and connect with the people who can help move those opportunities forward. Our vision is to help develop a stronger UK–Jamaica commercial corridor, one that encourages businesses to look beyond what already exists and explore what can be built together. From a British technology company partnering with Jamaican talent, to renewable-energy investment, infrastructure development, food manufacturing, professional services or a UK business establishing its Caribbean operations in Jamaica, the possibilities are significant. BJCC exists to help turn those possibilities into partnerships, investment and sustainable business. Two nations. One commercial bridge. A growing world of opportunity.

Located in Nad Al Sheba, just 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport and moments from Downtown Dubai, Meydan Free Zone sits within one of the city’s most distinctive settings. name: TransferMate Global Payments

Leading banks, fintechs and software providers partner with TransferMate to offer an enhanced user experience for their business customers. The TransferMate API solution allows partners to digitalise the payments flow within their software, enabling all businesses to achieve significant time and financial savings.

name: VAT IT
desc: VAT IT has been simplifying indirect tax for businesses worldwide for more than 25 years. With over 2,000 specialists across 30+ offices globally, we combine international reach with deep local expertise. Wherever our clients operate, they have access to professionals who understand the market, speak the language, and know how to navigate local tax requirements effectively. Our platforms are built to support businesses at every stage of growth, from expanding organisations to established global enterprises. By integrating directly with existing technology stacks, we make indirect tax a natural part of our clients' workflows rather than another operational burden. We believe indirect tax should enable growth, not slow it down. That's why we focus on removing complexity, reducing risk, and giving businesses the confidence to operate across borders with ease.

name: Vensure HR

name: Women in Business Network (WIBN)

Members benefit from: • Professional exclusivity within groups • SEO-optimised profiles on the WIBN website • Opportunities to promote their business through blogs, social media and events • Access to networking and collaboration opportunities across the UK • Free networking training and ongoing support.

name: Xpert Remote Staffing
desc: Xpert Remote Staffing enables UK and international businesses to access South Africa's exceptional talent pool without the complexity, risk, and administrative burden typically associated with cross-border employment. As a specialist Employer of Record (EOR) and international staffing provider, we help organisations recruit, employ, and manage highly skilled South African professionals while eliminating the need to establish a local entity or navigate the complexities of South African employment legislation. Our clients gain immediate access to qualified, English-speaking professionals across a wide range of industries, including technology, legal services, finance, accounting, recruitment, engineering, customer support, administration, and professional services. International hiring presents significant opportunities, but it also introduces legal and compliance challenges. Employment legislation, payroll obligations, statutory registrations, tax requirements, employee benefits, labour relations, and ongoing HR administration can create substantial risks for businesses unfamiliar with South African employment laws. Likewise, UK employers must ensure that their international employment arrangements are structured correctly and managed in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Xpert Remote Staffing removes these obstacles entirely. Through our comprehensive Employer of Record solution, we become the legal employer of the employee in South Africa while the employee works exclusively for your business. We manage employment contracts, payroll administration, statutory registrations, tax compliance, employee onboarding, HR administration, leave management, employee relations, and ongoing workforce support. This allows our clients to focus on growing their businesses while we handle the employment and compliance responsibilities. A key differentiator of Xpert Remote Staffing is our association with Luüs Attorneys, a specialist Employment and Labour Law practice with extensive experience in employment compliance, labour relations, workplace governance, and dispute resolution. This strategic partnership provides our clients with additional confidence that employment relationships are structured and managed in accordance with applicable legal requirements and best-practice employment standards. By combining professional staffing solutions with specialist employment law expertise, we provide a comprehensive solution that reduces legal risk, ensures statutory compliance, and gives businesses the confidence to hire internationally without uncertainty. Our mission is simple: to connect global businesses with outstanding South African talent while removing every obstacle associated with international employment. From recruitment and onboarding to payroll, HR administration, and legal compliance, Xpert Remote Staffing delivers a seamless, compliant, and cost-effective workforce solution that enables businesses to scale with confidence. Whether you are looking to hire a single specialist or build an entire remote team, Xpert Remote Staffing provides a trusted pathway to accessing South African talent without the complexity of managing South African or cross-border employment obligations.
